explication: SketchyBar is a configurable macOS status-bar replacement controlled by commands and shell scripts. The main workflow is command input to item/bar configuration, then manager-driven layout and drawing; events and scripts can update items dynamically, while mouse interaction and popup, graph, alias, and animation features extend the bar. The source index and excerpts support the main ownership links, but the startup wiring and several feature implementations were not sampled, so uncertain connections are omitted.
